title: Speaking feedback
description: Structured result of AI scoring for ONE audio answer of IELTS Academic Speaking (ontology v0), based on the transcript, the speech features and the optional pronunciation scores (see speaking_asr.schema.json). Estimated band for learning support, not an official score. Band per criterion is an integer 0-9; overall_band is the mean of the 4 criteria rounded to the nearest 0.5 (the backend recomputes it and does not trust the model). The Speaking band of a whole test (mean over the 3 Parts) is computed later and is not part of this schema. IDs follow ontology v0: CRIT_S_*, ERR_*, QT_S_PART*.

part.description: Part of the answer (QuestionType ID in ontology v0).

criteria.description: One entry per criterion, keyed by the Criterion ID of ontology v0. All four are required.

out_of_calibration_range.description: True when the result is outside the calibrated band range 4-8.

summary.description: Short overall comment for the learner.

improvements.description: What the learner should work on next.

comment.description: Why this band was given, based on the band descriptors. For CRIT_S_P, when pronunciation was null in the input, say that the band is only an indirect estimate.

quote.description: Exact phrase copied from the transcript (the backend drops evidence whose quote is not in the transcript). For a pause or a pronunciation problem, quote the words around the problem.

error_type.description: ErrorType ID of ontology v0 (Speaking only). Allowed per criterion (the backend drops evidence with a code of another criterion): CRIT_S_FC -> ERR_LONG_PAUSE, ERR_SELF_CORRECTION, ERR_SHORT_ANSWER; CRIT_S_LR -> ERR_WORD_CHOICE, ERR_COLLOCATION, ERR_REPETITION; CRIT_S_GRA -> ERR_ARTICLE, ERR_VERB_TENSE, ERR_SVA, ERR_NOUN_NUM, ERR_PREP, ERR_SENT_STRUCTURE; CRIT_S_P -> ERR_MISPRONOUNCE, ERR_WORD_STRESS, ERR_MONOTONE. ERR_SPELLING, ERR_WORD_FORM and ERR_PUNCT are Writing only. The backend derives SubSkill from the code through AFFECTS.

suggestion.description: How to fix or improve the quoted part.
